title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q1: Building a 3×3×3 Cube
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第1题：搭建 3×3×3 立方体

content.en: Mia is joining small cubes, adding one at a time, to build a 3×3×3 cube. She took pictures at 5 different moments. What does Mia’s third picture look like?
content.zh: 小米正在用小立方体搭建一个 3×3×3 的大立方体，每次添加一块小立方体。她在五个不同的时刻拍下照片。请问小米拍的第三张照片是什么样子？

explanation.en: As cubes are added, the count increases. The photo order is D, B, E, A, C; the third is E.
explanation.zh: 小立方体数量逐渐增加，五张照片顺序为 D、B、E、A、C，第三张是 E。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q2: Largest Result with Digits 2025
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第2题：用 2、0、2、5 得到最大结果

content.en: Simona writes the four digits 2, 0, 2, 5 in the four boxes. Which order would give her the largest result?
content.zh: 小西将 2、0、2、5 四个数字填入四个方框中。请问哪种顺序能让她得到最大的结果？

explanation.en: One digit is subtracted and the other three are added. Subtract the smallest digit 0: 5−0+2+2=9.
explanation.zh: 一个数被减去、另外三个相加。减去最小的 0：5−0+2+2=9，最大。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q3: Which Rope Ties a Knot
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第3题：哪根绳子会打结

content.en: Which rope ties into a knot when the ends are pulled?
content.zh: 请问下面哪根绳子在两端拉紧时会打成结？

explanation.en: Only a rope that forms a tightening loop (under–over–under) will knot; that is E.
explanation.zh: 只有形成收紧环（一股从另一股下、上、再下穿过）的绳子会打结，即 E。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q4: Tracks Beneath the Shoe
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第4题：鞋底下的印记

content.en: Alex stepped on some tracks on the ground. What is beneath her shoe?
content.zh: 小艾踩到了地上的一些印记。请问她鞋底的图案是什么样子？

explanation.en: Connecting the visible tracks shows the pattern matches option B.
explanation.zh: 把可见印记连起来，图案对应选项 B。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q5: Normal Dice Opposite Faces
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第5题：标准骰子相对面

content.en: On a normal dice, the total number of spots on two opposite faces is always 7. Which one of the dice shown could be a normal dice?
content.zh: 在一个标准的骰子上，相对的两个面上的点数之和总是 7。请问下面哪个骰子可能是一个标准的骰子？

explanation.en: Pairs 1–6, 2–5, 3–4 must be opposite. Only A does not force any of these pairs to be adjacent.
explanation.zh: 1 与 6、2 与 5、3 与 4 必须相对。只有 A 不会迫使这些对数相邻。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q6: Spinning Sail
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第6题：旋转的风车

content.en: Larissa spins her sail. Which of the sails below is hers?
content.zh: 小拉在旋转她的风车。请问下面哪个风车是她的？

explanation.en: Two black fields are opposite; the gray field is clockwise next to a black field → E.
explanation.zh: 两块黑色相对，灰色在黑色顺时针相邻处，对应 E。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q7: Kenny Jumps to a House
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第7题：袋鼠小肯跳到哪座房子

content.en: Kenny the Kangaroo jumps from the School to the Zoo as follows: ↑2, ↖2, ↙1, ←4. Then from the Zoo: →5, ↗2, ↑2. Which house will he get to?
content.zh: 袋鼠小肯从学校跳到动物园：↑2, ↖2, ↙1, ←4。再从动物园：→5, ↗2, ↑2。请问它会跳到哪座房子？

explanation.en: Following the path from the Zoo leads to house B.
explanation.zh: 从动物园按路线走，到达房子 B。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q8: Pinwheel with Three Rods
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第8题：三根小棒搭风车

content.en: Which pinwheel can Jorge build with these 3 rods?
content.zh: 请问小豪可以用这 3 根小棒搭建出哪个风车？

explanation.en: The rod with two green triangles has both on the same side; only E matches all three rods.
explanation.zh: 带两个绿色三角形的小棒上两三角形同侧，只有 E 能用这三根小棒搭成。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q9: Shells and Marbles Value 15
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第9题：贝壳与弹珠总值 15

content.en: Nico and his little sister pay with shells and marbles. Each shell has value 6 and each marble has value 1. Which has a total value of 15?
content.zh: 小尼和妹妹用贝壳和弹珠支付。每个贝壳价值 6，每个弹珠价值 1。请问下列哪个选项的总价值是 15？

explanation.en: Option B: 1 shell + 9 marbles = 6+9 = 15.
explanation.zh: 选项 B：1 个贝壳 + 9 个弹珠 = 6+9 = 15。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q10: Sharing Kangaroo Cookies
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第10题：分享袋鼠饼干

content.en: Anna, Bonnie and Caspar have some kangaroo cookies on their plates, as shown. They share the remaining 15 cookies so everyone has the same number. How many more cookies does Bonnie get?
content.zh: 小安、小波和小卡盘子里各有一些袋鼠饼干。他们分享托盘上剩余的 15 块饼干，使每人数量相同。请问小波又得到了多少块饼干？

explanation.en: They have 3, 4, 5 cookies; total with 15 is 27, so each gets 9. Bonnie needs 9−4=5 more.
explanation.zh: 已有 3、4、5 块，加上 15 共 27，每人 9 块。小波还需 9−4=5 块。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q11: Whose Phone Is Edward’s
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第11题：哪部手机是小爱的

content.en: In the morning, 5 friends had identical fully-charged phones. By evening, Bob had spoken as much as Ann and Cristina together. Bob ran out of power. David had not used his phone at all. Which phone belonged to Edward?
content.zh: 早上 5 个朋友各有一部满电的相同手机。晚上小鲍的通话时间等于小安和小克之和。小鲍手机没电了，小戴完全没用手机。请问哪部手机是小爱的？

explanation.en: Bob is phone 3 (empty), David is phone 1 (full). Phones 4 and 5 sum to one full battery (Ann & Cristina). Phone 2 is Edward’s.
explanation.zh: 小鲍是 3 号（没电），小戴是 1 号（满电）。4 与 5 电量相加等于一整格（小安、小克）。2 号属于小爱。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 Q12: Complete the Chessboard
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-1 第12题：补全棋盘

content.en: Which two of the pieces shown below complete the chessboard?
content.zh: 请问下面哪两块碎片可以补全这个棋盘？

explanation.en: After rotating, pieces 4 and 5 fit the holes with correct coloring.
explanation.zh: 旋转后，碎片 4 和 5 形状与着色都吻合缺口。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q13: Food for Six Sheep
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第13题：六只羊的干粮

content.en: Renée feeds 6 sheep a total of 210 grams of dry food. The smallest sheep gets twice as much as each of the others. How much does the smallest sheep get?
content.zh: 小芮给 6 只羊共分发 210 克干粮。最小的羊获得的是其他每只羊的两倍。请问最小的羊得到了多少克干粮？

explanation.en: Count the small sheep as two shares: 7 shares of 30 g; smallest gets 60 g.
explanation.zh: 把最小的羊算作两份：共 7 份，每份 30 克，最小的羊得 60 克。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q14: Pizza Cuts Equal Tomatoes
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第14题：披萨均分番茄

content.en: Tom wishes to slice a pizza into 2 halves with the same number of tomatoes on each half. It is possible with two different cuts. Along which lines could he cut?
content.zh: 小汤想把披萨切成两半，且每半番茄数量相同。已知有两种不同切法可以实现。请问他可以沿着哪些线来切？

explanation.en: Cuts 2 and 4 each give 9 tomatoes on both halves.
explanation.zh: 沿 2 和沿 4 切割时，两边番茄都是 9 个。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q15: Number Pyramid Star
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第15题：数字金字塔中的星号

content.en: Maria fills the circles with 1–7. Each lower circle equals the sum of the two connected circles above it. What number is in the circle marked with ★?
content.zh: 小玛在圆圈里填入 1–7。下方每个圆圈等于上方相连两圆之和。请问标有 ★ 的圆圈里的数字是什么？

explanation.en: Working from the given 6, the star (bottom middle) must be 4.
explanation.zh: 由已给出的 6 推导，★（下排中间）是 4。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q16: Fourth Piece of the Square
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第16题：正方形的第四块

content.en: Bob makes a square from 4 rectangular pieces. 3 of the pieces he uses are shown. Which of the following is the fourth piece he uses?
content.zh: 小鲍用 4 块长方形碎片拼出一个正方形。其中 3 块如图所示。请问下列哪个选项是他用的第四块碎片？

explanation.en: The square is 6×6=36 cells; three pieces use 24, so the fourth has 12 cells — option E.
explanation.zh: 大正方形为 6×6=36 格，三块共 24 格，第四块 12 格，对应 E。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q17: Ladybirds Fourth Photo
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第17题：瓢虫第四张照片

content.en: 6 ladybirds have 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 spots. Marta took 4 photos of groups of 3. Each ladybird appeared the same number of times. How many spots do the three ladybirds in the fourth photo have in total?
content.zh: 6 只瓢虫斑点分别为 1–6。小玛拍了 4 张照片，每张 3 只，每只出现次数相同。请问第四张照片里三只瓢虫斑点总数是多少？

explanation.en: Ladybirds 1,3,5 appear twice in the first three photos; 2,4,6 once. The fourth photo has 2+4+6=12.
explanation.zh: 前三张中 1、3、5 各出现两次，2、4、6 各一次。第四张是 2+4+6=12。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q18: Paper Snowflake Cuts
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第18题：纸雪花裁剪

content.en: Nela folds a paper square in half and then in half again. She cuts pieces out. After unfolding she sees a paper snowflake. How did she cut the folded piece of paper?
content.zh: 小娜把正方形纸对折两次后剪掉几块，展开后得到纸雪花。请问她是如何裁剪这张折好的纸的？

explanation.en: Each quarter of the snowflake matches cutting pattern B.
explanation.zh: 雪花每一象限的图案对应裁剪方式 B。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q19: Black and Grey Pyramid
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第19题：黑灰立方体金字塔

content.en: Leonia built a pyramid with black and grey cubes so that no face of a cube touches another cube of the same colour. One black cube is shown. What will the pyramid look like from above?
content.zh: 小莉用黑、灰立方体搭金字塔，同色立方体面不相贴。其中一个黑色立方体如图所示。请问从上面看，金字塔是什么样子？

explanation.en: The cube under the shown black must be grey, forcing bottom X,Z black and Y grey → D.
explanation.zh: 图中黑块正下方必为灰，从而底层 X、Z 为黑、Y 为灰，俯视图为 D。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q20: Calendar First Day
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第20题：日历第一天是星期几

content.en: The picture shows one month of a calendar without dates. The total of the dates for the 2 shaded days is 31. On what day of the week does the first day of the month fall?
content.zh: 图中展示了一个月的日历页（未标日期）。两个阴影日期之和是 31。请问这个月的第一天是星期几？

explanation.en: The shaded dates differ by 13 and sum to 31 → 9 and 22. Day 1 is 8 days before the 9th → Wednesday.
explanation.zh: 两日期相差 13 且和为 31，即 9 与 22。1 号比 9 号早 8 天，是星期三。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q21: Size of Each Brick
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第21题：每块砖的尺寸

content.en: The construction uses 11 identical bricks. It has length 100 cm and width 60 cm. What is the size of each brick?
content.zh: 如图建筑使用了 11 块相同的砖，长 100 cm、宽 60 cm。请问每块砖的尺寸是多少？

explanation.en: Height is 6 brick-heights: 60÷6=10 cm. Length is 4×height=40 cm → 40×10.
explanation.zh: 高度为 6 块砖高：60÷6=10 cm；砖长为高的 4 倍=40 cm，即 40×10。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q22: How Many Bananas
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第22题：有多少根香蕉

content.en: Rossitza listed counts of different fruits; some digits are covered by paint. In total she has 106 pieces. Two types have equal counts; one type is twice another. She has more than 10 of each type. How many bananas does she have?
content.zh: 小罗写下了各种水果数量，部分数字被颜料遮住。一共 106 个；有两种数量相同；有一种是另一种的两倍；每种都超过 10 个。请问她有多少根香蕉？

explanation.en: Apples=oranges=30; mangoes=2×pears with pears≥11 → mangoes≥22. Minimum for four types is 93, so bananas ≤13 and >10 → 13.
explanation.zh: 苹果=橙子=30；芒果是梨的两倍且梨≥11→芒果≥22。前四种至少 93，香蕉≤13 且>10，故为 13。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q23: Least Water After Removing Balls
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第23题：取出球后水最少的试管

content.en: Identical balls are in 5 identical test tubes; then water is added. Levels in tubes 1–3 are the same; levels in 4–5 are the same and twice as high. After all balls are removed, which test tube has the least water?
content.zh: 5 个相同试管中放入相同的球后加水。试管 1–3 水位相同；4 与 5 水位相同且为前三者两倍。取出所有球后，哪个试管里的水最少？

explanation.en: With the same water level, more balls mean less water. Tube 3 has the least among 1–3; tube 5 has twice tube 3’s water, so tube 3 has the least overall.
explanation.zh: 同水位时球越多水越少。1–3 中 3 最少；5 的水量是 3 的两倍，故整体最少是试管 3。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 Q24: Mass of One Star
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2025 – Level 2-2 第24题：一颗星的质量

content.en: A pair of scales weighs 3 different objects (results shown). Each type has a different mass from {1,2,3,4,5} kg. What is the mass of one ★ in kilograms?
content.zh: 用天平称量 3 种不同物体（结果如图）。每种质量不同，可能是 1–5 千克。请问一颗 ★ 的质量是多少千克？

explanation.en: Circle=5, square=3, star=1 satisfies both weighings.
explanation.zh: 圆=5、方=3、星=1 满足两次称量结果。

meta.level_zh: 等级 B / Level 2（3–4 年级）
